scope: Migration parity for selected M3; not a new training run or classification-benefit experiment
selected_variant: pair_joint both + old VV + null-centered VH + B-anchored frequency gate
receipt_source: Numerical outputs from completed validation commands, recorded without rerunning

cached_feature_parity.independence_note: Three seeds evaluate the same 1741 records; 5223 is not an independent-sample count
cached_feature_parity.comparison: Recomputed reference retrieval, learned matching, polar heads, gate descriptors and final scores against frozen historical outputs

raw_chip_extraction_parity.selection: First utility_train, selection, evaluation and strategy_fit records, plus first missing-VH record; duplicate indices removed
raw_chip_extraction_parity.scope: Original uint8 chip plus historical geometry preparation -> shared frozen R50 maps -> new M3 extraction
raw_chip_extraction_parity.input_preparation_note: Historical preparation is used only in this validation fixture to isolate M3 extraction. Full standalone input-to-classification integration is validated separately by the main thread

checks: Fractional pixel mass on true Voronoi grid cells
Token masks partition the original OBB regions
Dustbin transport matches and rejects known examples
Null-centered VH is zero for absent evidence; gate reverts to anchor for missing polarization

reproduction.legacy_root_meaning: Local model_closeout_20261023 directory containing the frozen historical fixtures
reproduction.requirements: Use the project Python environment and already exported assets. Legacy fixtures are required only for parity testing; raw extraction parity additionally requires the original local chips
reproduction.effects: Reads inputs and prints numerical JSON receipts; does not train, refit scalers, alter checkpoints or overwrite historical results
reproduction.privacy: This report contains no private absolute paths, credentials or original images

limitations: Cached-feature parity tests M3 downstream of feature extraction; it does not alone establish full raw-chip parity
Five raw extraction records are targeted migration checks, not full-dataset raw extraction coverage
No claim of new accuracy improvement, physical causality or novel model selection follows from these parity results
